s11.title: Behind the Bumpers | 5460 Strike Zone | Charged Up Robot

bet.text: Keep the entire upper structure as light as possible, because past robots had center of gravity trouble.

auto.text: A commenter in the Einstein thread implies its auto did not place the first cone consistently.

cycle.text: Cubes go from the ground intake out to the low nodes. Forward and reverse station buttons let it pick up from both sides without a full turn.
Before the state championship the claw took mid and high cubes from the shelf, with no handoff.
A commenter says it seemed the fastest robot on Einstein at the double feeder.

fallback.text: Driver-station overrides cover the gyro and other sensors such as beam breaks.

gave_up.text: Before the state championship it did no cube handoff from intake to claw: testing found inconsistencies that put the arm in vulnerable positions. Mid and high cubes came from the shelf, to avoid a popped cube or a damaged robot.

changed.text: After the first event a roller was added so the intake takes cones too.
Two Limelights on AprilTags gave way to targeting the nodes.
Before the state championship: L3 drive gearing, a 120:1 distal arm, a half pound off the end effector, its motor moved for less rotational mass, and no AprilTag alignment.
Offseason: two more drive motors, for ten.

outcome.text: 64-28-0 in official play; won the Daly division; championship finalist; captain of the Daly alliance on Einstein; ranked 19 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 70.01, Daly).

solves.text: Pick up from the ground and spit cubes straight into low nodes

facts.text: Took cubes only at the first event; an added roller lets it take cones
Uses no pneumatics, which the team calls more consistent
One Falcon deploys it, at the reveal at
One Falcon drives the rollers, at the reveal at

functions.name: Carbon fiber arm

solves.text: Reach the nodes with a low center of gravity

functions.type: jointed arm of large carbon fiber tube

facts.text: Driven from a gearbox low in the robot
Upper structure without the Falcon is under about 7 lb
Inserts are press fit and epoxied, with one hot glued
Distal joint, changed before the state championship to
A commenter notes angled inserts that bring the end effector to the middle of the robot
Two Falcons, at the reveal at
A precision aluminum tube pressed into the printed joint gives better tolerance for the bearings, which ride on another aluminum tube as a dead axle
The press-fit and epoxied tube joint rarely saw axial load; joints that did see high axial load used the same method with no issues
Before the state championship a position to pick cubes off the ground was in development, but it too left the arm vulnerable and made the team uneasy

cost.text: The tube is expensive, so the team feared cracking it

The part joining the vertical tube, first printed in Onyx as two pieces held by dowel pins and epoxy, split along its layer lines; the joint between the pieces held. The laser-sintered Nylon 12 part that replaced it had not failed

Weight at the reveal
Thrifty Bot wheels
Printed gears on nylon hex shaft with aluminum bolts; deeper teeth held better
Gears and pulleys were printed in Onyx to keep the arm's swinging inertia low

cost.text: An observer who reviewed playoff footage of its Macomb event names dropped cones and trouble at the loading station among the reasons it did not play a clean match

facts.text: Its MK4i modules went from L2 at the reveal to L3 gearing before the state championship, for speed

solves.text: Aim at the nodes and score more easily

facts.text: It was easier to target and score with than two Limelights on AprilTags
It tracks the reflective tape on the node poles and fits the driver better than tags did; tags could match it, but only with a lot of development
Tag pose updates worked within reason, with one of the two cameras always seeing at least two tags when scoring, but there was not enough time to tune them to a competitive level
Tag odometry allowed zone-based gyro locks when scoring and collecting, but lacked efficiency in positioning the robot for scoring and was scrapped after the week 3 event

facts.text: Added between the championship and IRI; calculated free speed after it, about
The two modules changed sit next to each other and were the easiest to reach; the one under the arm gearbox was left alone
Three-motor modules use L1 gears with a 24-tooth pinion; two-motor modules use L3 with an 18-tooth pinion
The 18-tooth pinion needs a relocating plate, machined from 3/8 in aluminum on the team's router
The two ratios differ by 0.011:1, so code slows the two-motor modules to match
At first each second drive Falcon followed the first, with a driver-station switch to disable the extra motors near a brownout
Dry robot weight with it at IRI

solves.text: Add drive motors while trying to avoid the brownouts reported by teams on twelve

cost.text: Two brownouts in 26 matches over two events

decisions.choice: Gearbox low, printed claw gears, carbon tube
decisions.because: low mass up high keeps the center of gravity low

decisions.choice: No intake-to-claw handoff for cubes, for now (before the state championship)
decisions.because: testing showed inconsistencies that left the arm vulnerable, with the risk of a popped cube or a damaged robot
decisions.cost: mid and high cubes come from the shelf

decisions.because: it was easier to target and to score with, and there was not enough time to tune tags to a competitive level
the belt slips before the wheels tear or mark a game piece
decisions.instead_of: a tight belt, with wheels that slipped on the pieces

decisions.choice: Nylon 12 for the arm tube joint
decisions.because: the Onyx print split along its layer lines; the sintered part is solid and does not delaminate
decisions.instead_of: a two-piece Onyx print with dowel pins and epoxy

decisions.because: they shipped next day and, of many companies asked, only they gave an educational discount

decisions.choice: Ten drive motors rather than twelve (offseason)
decisions.because: the team thought twelve too many, and its simulations and one match watched side by side showed very little difference at its weight
